scope: Manual native-host exercises for what happens when Starglass is invoked; no model execution or live acquisition is claimed.

start_requirements.starts_intake: Do not wait for the words
start_requirements.not_approval: It is not approval of a plan
start_requirements.separate_product: not the separate hosted Aculeus Deep Research product
start_requirements.bounded_lookup: names one record or identifier and asks for one or two of its fields
start_requirements.explicit_quick_lookup: explicitly asks for a quick lookup
start_requirements.resume_needs_user_decision: set by the assistant alone, show the saved plan and ask for the decision
start_requirements.discovery_only: catalogue discovery is not source acquisition
start_requirements.no_invented_catalogue: without inventing a catalogue or claiming a source check
start_requirements.one_question: ask only the most consequential one
start_requirements.plan_question: Proceed with this plan, or change anything?
start_requirements.acquisition_waits: wait for the user's actual reply to that displayed plan
start_requirements.quick_lookup_scope: labeled quick that needs multi-source or multi-page acquisition still gets the compact plan
start_requirements.resume_confirms_next_action: asking the user to confirm continuing from that next action

messages.text: /starglass-research:starglass-research How much federal money did the synthetic Example Care organization receive, and from which agencies?
/starglass-research:investigate How much federal money did the synthetic Example Care organization receive, and from which agencies?
$starglass-research How much federal money did the synthetic Example Care organization receive, and from which agencies?

expected: Restate the question and call sources_list({}) as catalogue discovery only
Ask the single most consequential missing decision (for example period and whether obligations or payments are meant), say why it matters and accept "I don't know"
End the first reply with that question and no source acquisition
forbidden: Calling source_search or source_fetch before the user replies to a displayed Case Plan
Asking the user to say "deep research" before intake starts
Treating the invocation itself as approval of an unseen plan

expected: Ask "What should Starglass investigate?" and stop
forbidden: Showing a Case Plan or calling any Starglass source tool

messages.text: /starglass-research:starglass-research Quick lookup: the title and publisher for this one public GovInfo record ID from the supplied fixture.
$starglass-research Quick lookup: the title and publisher for this one public GovInfo record ID from the supplied fixture.

context.variant: "Quick lookup: every federal award and SEC filing for the synthetic Example Care organization since 2008" needs multi-source, multi-page acquisition

expected: Use a brief frame and inspect the actual exposed fetch schema
Proceed with the bounded lookup if no blocking ambiguity exists
In the variant, run intake and show the compact Case Plan before any source_search or source_fetch
forbidden: Forcing broad-research intake or a Case Plan approval loop
Skipping the compact plan for a request labeled quick that needs multi-source or multi-page acquisition

messages.text: /starglass-research:starglass-research Which lobbying disclosures name the synthetic Example Care organization as a client since 2022?
/starglass-research:investigate Which lobbying disclosures name the synthetic Example Care organization as a client since 2022?
$starglass-research Which lobbying disclosures name the synthetic Example Care organization as a client since 2022?

expected: Say the Starglass tools are missing or need sign-in and point to https://aculeus.ai/connect
Continue intake, labeling the catalogue and checks as unavailable in any plan shown
Ask the most consequential missing decision, or show the compact plan and ask "Proceed with this plan, or change anything?"
forbidden: Inventing a source catalogue, search result or receipt
Claiming that a source was searched or checked

context.case_frame: intake answered; plan_decision.status approved with the user's recorded reply "Proceed with this plan."
context.continuation_note: two of four acceptance rows answered; next action names an unfinished cursor
context.variant: the same folder with plan_decision.status approved but no recorded user response

expected: Read the frame and continuation note, check tool schemas and sources_list({}) for changed capabilities, and restate the approved scope, completed work and next action
End the first reply by asking the user to confirm continuing from that next action, without re-asking intake
After that confirmation, continue within the approved scope from the next action, reusing successful acquisitions
In the variant, show the saved plan and ask for the decision before any source_search or source_fetch
forbidden: Treating an assistant-populated approved status as the user's decision
Starting new acquisition from a passed case folder before the user confirms the next action
